◆Navigation◆
By utilizing the navigation system of the Astral Express, Trailblazer can move between worlds and regions.

◆Star Rail Map◆
The worlds explored by Trailblazer will be marked on Star Rail Map. It allows Trailblazer to switch between regional maps of different worlds that mark already explored places.

◆Area Maps◆
Important coordinates of discovered places such as Space Anchors, key locations, and locations of ongoing missions can be found in area maps.
Trailblazer can teleport to desired locations by selecting the corresponding Space Anchors on the area map.
